fn bound<const N: usize>() -> usize {
    N
}
fn drain(control: &mut Consumer<Record>) {
    let available = control.available_at_entry();
    for _ in 0..available + bound::<{ usize::MAX }>() {
        let Ok(record) = control.try_pop() else {
            break;
        };
        apply(record);
    }
}
